entries.title: Session attendance, room fit suggestions, and room draw in the Speaker Score
entries.summary: **Pathways → Attendees → By session** shows registered, checked in, capacity, fill and show rate for every session, filled by **Import attendance** (a total per session or one row per person). **Program → Agenda** gains a **Room fit** panel that forecasts turnout from past events and moves overflowing sessions to a free room that fits. **Settings → Speaker Score** is a blend editor with a live preview for any speaker, and a new **Room draw** lane.

where.path: Event → Pathways → Attendees → By session; Event → Program → Agenda → List; Settings → Speaker Score; Pathways → Topics

entries.use_case: A program team imports last year's badge scans, sees that the AI track overflowed every room while the policy track ran half empty, moves this year's AI sessions into the ballroom from the Room fit panel, and lets room draw count toward who gets invited back.

cs_action.note: Pathways is an Early Access Beta: enable feature--pathways on the organization after the customer requests it from Preview. The Room fit panel stays hidden until at least one other event in the org has check-ins, so start with a CSV import of a past event. Room draw weight is 0 until the customer raises it in Settings → Speaker Score.

internal.when_to_bring_up: Room-planning conversations, complaints about overflowing or empty breakouts, speaker re-invite decisions, and any customer who already exports badge-scan or session-scan data from their registration platform.
internal.who_should_get_it: Pathways beta customers with multi-track events and at least one past event's session check-ins — medical and scientific meetings and large association conferences first.
internal.gotchas: Per-person rows only match people already registered for the event by email; unmatched rows are listed, not created. Re-importing a session replaces its earlier upload. Cvent session enrollment and check-in pull exists in the connector behind a sync setting that is off by default and has not been verified against a live Cvent account, so do not offer it yet.
internal.talk_track: Bring last year's door counts and we'll tell you which sessions need a bigger room this year, and which speakers actually fill one.
